graphChecks.notes: No new package edge. The sensitive change is the opposite of a widening: admin session listings and CSV exports now stop at a bounded row count in SQL instead of materialising the whole table, and counts are derived from the same filter so page totals cannot drift.

knownGaps: Human gate pending: the maintainer must confirm export compatibility and the 10000-row cap (pkg/impexp.MaxExportRows).

Truncation is not machine-readable: an over-cap export is silently narrowed to the newest MaxExportRows rows with no CSV header/flag. Adding a truncation marker is explicitly out of this task's scope and would change the export response shape.

The EXPLAIN before/after comparison in summary.md comes from the implementation-time run against the live pantheon_base database; it was not re-executed during this closeout, and the index is now owned by migration 000018 rather than by hand-issued ALTERs.
